svg.text: Full-size 830-point breadboard (63 rows). Relay dot ● goes top-left.
Left of the canyon = Pi land (blue). Right of the canyon = treadmill land (orange). − = GND rail, S = SHARED rail.
green wire: SHARED rail (treadmill side only)
The outer rails (+ on the left, the far right one) are not used. Never plug anything from Pi land into the SHARED rail.
Check GPIO rows against the labels printed on your cobbler: the labels win.
